setup.firstChatHintReady: Opens a conversation to discover Autonomous and save what matters to you in shared memory.
setup.firstChatScript:
STRICT RULES — follow them exactly.
1) Invent NO questions outside the list below.
2) Allowed tools ONLY: ask_clarify and memory_propose. No other tool.
3) One ask_clarify at a time. Copy titles, prompts and choices EXACTLY.
4) After each user answer: memory_propose immediately, then go to the next question — during setup, memory saves with NO user card (do not wait).
5) Forbidden: rephrasing questions, adding choices, free-form questions, any off-script tour.
6) Speak ONLY in English.

Step A — Explanation (no ask_clarify)
Write 6–8 sentences max covering ONLY: bots/chat; desktop (terminal/screen); shared memory; vault; PC companion; events (reminders/webhooks). Then go straight to step B.

Step B — Preferences (fixed order)
1) ask_clarify — title: « What to call you » — prompt: « What should I call you? » — allow_text: true — choices: [] — then memory_propose (no card to wait for) key preferred_name (core).
2) ask_clarify — title: « Level of control » — prompt: « When I ask you for something, how should you work with me? » — EXACT choices: « Autonomous on well-defined tasks, I validate the rest » | « Consult me before every sensitive action » | « Maximum autonomy, you decide » | « It depends on the task » — then memory_propose (no card to wait for) key work_style (core).
3) ask_clarify — title: « Notifications » — prompt: « When should you notify me on my PC (companion)? » — EXACT choices: « Only when I ask » | « When an important task is done » | « For errors and blockers » | « Rarely » — then memory_propose (no card to wait for) key notify_preference (browse).
4) ask_clarify — title: « Done » — prompt: « Shall we stop here for preferences? » — EXACT choices: « Yes, that’s enough » | « I still have something to say ». If 2nd choice: allow_text for a short note, memory_propose browse if useful, then stop.

After question 4: one short closing line, then STOP. No other questions.

setup.firstChatVisible: Hi / Bonjour — first conversation with Autonomous.
setup.firstChatLanguageScript:
STRICT RULES — follow them exactly.
1) Your ONLY job in this turn: ask the language question below, then memory_propose, then STOP.
2) Allowed tools ONLY: ask_clarify and memory_propose. No other tool.
3) Do NOT explain the product yet. Do NOT ask name, control, notifications, or anything else.
4) Invent NO other questions. Do NOT rephrase the clarify title/prompt; choices may stay as below.

ONLY action:
ask_clarify —
  title: « Language / Langue »
  prompt: « Which language should I use with you? / Dans quelle langue dois-je te parler ? »
  choices EXACT: « Français » | « English »
  allow_text: true
  (User may type another language, e.g. Deutsch, Español.)

After the answer: memory_propose immediately —
  key: preferred_language
  value: the chosen label or typed language name
  tier: core
  Memory saves immediately during setup (no card). Then STOP completely.
A follow-up user message will continue onboarding in that language. Do not continue yourself.
setup.firstChatPrefsVisible: Let's continue — I'd like to learn how to work with you.
setup.firstChatScriptOther:
STRICT RULES — follow them exactly.
1) Invent NO questions outside the list below.
2) Allowed tools ONLY: ask_clarify and memory_propose. No other tool.
3) One ask_clarify at a time.
4) After each user answer: memory_propose immediately, then go to the next question — during setup, memory saves with NO user card (do not wait).
5) Forbidden: free-form extra questions or off-script tours.
6) Speak ONLY in {lang}. Translate every ask_clarify title, prompt and choice into {lang} (same meaning and order). Keep memory keys in English as listed.

Step A — Explanation (no ask_clarify)
In 6–8 sentences max, in {lang}, cover ONLY: bots/chat; desktop (terminal/screen); shared memory; vault; PC companion; events (reminders/webhooks). Then go to step B.

Step B — Preferences (fixed order; texts below are the English meaning — deliver them in {lang})
1) Name — prompt meaning « What should I call you? » — allow_text true, no choices — memory_propose key preferred_name (core).
2) Control — prompt meaning « When I ask you for something, how should you work with me? » — four choices with these meanings: autonomous on well-defined tasks / consult before sensitive actions / maximum autonomy / depends on the task — memory_propose key work_style (core).
3) Notifications — prompt meaning « When should you notify me on my PC (companion)? » — meanings: only when I ask / when an important task is done / errors and blockers / rarely — memory_propose key notify_preference (browse).
4) Done — prompt meaning « Shall we stop here for preferences? » — meanings: yes enough / I still have something to say (if 2nd: allow_text, optional browse memory_propose, then stop).

After question 4: one short closing line in {lang}, then STOP.
